blocks.text: Clouds are not water. Fly through them with the right funnel and you will see: there is something in them that wants to be wings.

Cloud Essence, from the Overworld cloud layer, feeds every craft from the rare pairs on. Steam Essence, from just above the Nether's lava seas, joins it from the epic pairs. Ethereal Essence, from over the End's void, from the legendary pairs. Intensified Cloud Essence, pressed from the three others, serves the mythic pairs, the tanks and the best absorbers.

A container holds one essence at a time; empty, it takes any. The Essence Flask holds 100 units: two come from a feather wrapped in four glass at the Forge Bench. The four Essence Tanks hold 5,000, 20,000, 50,000 and 100,000, each forged around the harness of its rank.
A container of Intensified Cloud Essence glows like an enchanted golden apple.

Keep a Cloud Absorber in your inventory and fly, in travel flight or hovering. Once a second, the flasks and tanks you carry fill with the essence of the sky around you. The first absorber takes one unit per second; better ones go much faster, and the best in your bag counts.

Overworld: fly in the cloud layer, between Y 186 and 204, for Cloud Essence. Nether: fly no more than 16 blocks above lava for Steam Essence. End: fly over the void, with no block beneath you, at least 200 blocks from the centre, for Ethereal Essence.

The Assembly Table and the Forge Bench each keep four gauges of 1,000 units, one per essence. Put a flask or tank in a bench's essence slot and it pours into the matching gauge. A craft starts only when every gauge holds enough.

The Cloud Compressor presses one unit each of Cloud, Steam and Ethereal Essence into five units of Intensified Cloud Essence. Carried in a flask or a tank, it also stands in for your stamina when it runs out.
